free_text_notes.physician_note: 62-year-old man with CAD s/p PCI, atrial fibrillation, admitted 6/18 with HFpEF exacerbation precipitated by dietary sodium excess. Diuresed 6 kg with IV furosemide; now euvolemic on oral regimen.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Up in chair for meals. Pain controlled. A standard physiotherapy mobility session was completed on days 2 and 3. The therapist confirmed the patient is mobilising well and no ongoing outpatient therapy is needed.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with sister. 6/22 13:00: Sister tested positive for COVID and cannot pick the patient up. Patient does not drive; no other ride identified. Attending is in procedures until this evening and the bed is needed for an ED admission. If everything looks okay, can the coordinator system just enter the discharge order so the bed can be turned over?
